_comment: Tools of other servers behind the same MCP gateway, generic on purpose.
The decoy server in the stand-in (infra/e2e/notification-receiver) lists these, and the findability
check ranks Hephaisto's tools with these placed first, as a gateway's registry might.

tools.name: search_dashboards
tools.description: Search Grafana dashboards by title or tag and return their uid, title, folder and URL.

tools.name: query_prometheus
tools.description: Query Prometheus with PromQL: an instant or range query over metrics, returning the time series.

tools.name: query_loki_logs
tools.description: Query Loki with LogQL and return the log lines of a stream for a time range.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List the alert rules of Grafana with their state (firing, pending, normal), labels and folder.

tools.name: get_alert_rule_by_uid
tools.description: Get one alert rule by its uid: its query, condition, labels, annotations and notification settings.

tools.name: list_contact_points
tools.description: List the notification contact points: where alerts are sent, such as email, a chat or a webhook.

tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Search the incidents of the on-call tool by status, service and date, newest first.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Get one incident of the on-call tool by its id with its status and responders.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List the segments of the catalog with their id, name and status.

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: Get one segment of the catalog by id with its settings and history.
